t: Twin pack comprising of an ergonomic combi drill and impact driver. Both tools feature a brushless motor, XR technology and are equipped with LED work lights for enhanced visibility in low-light conditions. Ideal for consistent screw driving into a variety of materials with different screw sizes. Impact driver features a 1/4" hex fitment and requires hex bits. Combi drill features 13mm chuck, hammer function allowing efficient drilling into masonry and concrete, and is compatible with both hex and round shank bits. Supplied with TSTAK compatible carry case, charger and 2 x 2.0Ah batteries.
